newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle active at $69, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle active at $69, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher than last week. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 4,700 slaughter steers and 7,600 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 21,700 head confirmed including 3,600 head or about 17 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 950-1175 lbs
